newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks resume climb, Telefonica outperforms.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks resume climb, Telefonica outperforms.

text.p: MADRID, June 5 (Reuter) (1535 GMT) - Madrid shares regained momentum late in the afternoon on Thursday, but traders said the rise seemed exaggerated given that little fresh had happened to push the bourse higher.
"To me it seems that the move is a bit exaggerated, but it seems that people are again committing to a higher market. Fund money continues to enter and outlook is positive," a futures dealer said.
* The Madrid general index closed up 8.77 points, or 1.57 percent, to 566.24. The Ibex-35 rose 103.00 points, or 1.61 percent, to 6,514,40 points.
* Telefonica outperformed, rising 100 points, or 2.37 percent, to 4,315 pesetas. Dealers said this did not reflect concrete news, but ongoing overall positive sentiment.
* Repsol benefitted from news net cash flow rose 20 percent in the first four months of the year. Shares rose 90 pesetas, or 1.45 percent, to 6,290 pesetas.
* Constructors OCP and Gines Navarro were the markets star performers ending up nearly 15 percent on merger specifics.
* Volume was low as dealers awaited more news on progress toward EMU. There was a surge in activity in late trade, which dealers attributed possibly to a programme or basket trade.
